test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ISLAND' is written as 'HTKBME' and 'TABLET' is written as 'SBAMDU'. How will 'BANGLE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'ISLAND' is written as 'HTKBME',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fc6c46e0761d1237239fa7d415ff1cd27aa3873c3a40a70528226242956c3a.png] 

For, 'TABLET' is written as 'SBAMDU',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c64ce8820a81547b4c5428045a6f448657e3bcfe0fc8470d7e1d295d5374e63.png] 

Similarly, for '**BANGLE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab46adcd51aa9facf370d8939382a33e3098144ee2e46c939311c9945240db00.png] 

So, '**BANGLE**' is coded as '**ABMHKF**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
